name: Maya's Return to a Changed Pakistan
description: The streets of Pakistan appeared different now—more heavily guarded, tense, watched. Military checkpoints lined the roads, and armed patrols moved through the cities with routine precision. Amid this altered landscape, a grey sedan came into view, parked quietly in a narrow alley near a shuttered market. The car bore the wear of long travel, its windows dusted with dry earth. It was Maya's, left idle but not abandoned, a quiet sign that she had come back.
related_events: Maya's grey sedan is discovered in a changed Pakistan

name: Joseph Bradley Sits at His Desk Amid Crisis
description: Joseph Bradley sits at his desk, his face drawn and heavy with emotion. The room is dimly lit, the glow of a television flickering across the walls. On the screen, chaotic images of a disaster unfold—people running, buildings in ruins, emergency crews rushing through smoke. He does not look away, his hands resting motionless on the desk, shoulders slumped as the sounds of sirens and shouting fill the room.
related_events: Joseph Bradley sits at his desk under emotional distress

name: Guards Force-Feed Faraj Through a Feeding Tube
description: The guards restrain Faraj and insert a feeding tube, forcing him to ingest food as he resists the procedure.
related_events: Guards force feed Faraj through a feeding tube

name: Boarding the Frigate in Warsaw
description: A dark-haired woman and a man arrive at a sprawling shipyard in an industrial area of Warsaw, Poland. They approach a large military frigate docked in the harbor and board the vessel.
related_events: Woman and man board military frigate at Warsaw shipyard

name: Maya Retching in Bathroom Stall
description: Maya is in a bathroom stall, bent over, her body heaving as she retches violently. The sound of her gagging echoes against the tiled walls. She clutches the stall door for support, her face pale and strained.
related_events: Maya retching in the bathroom stall

name: Maya Wakes to the Call to Prayer
description: The loud wailing of the early morning call to prayer echoes from the loudspeakers of a nearby mosque, cutting through the quiet of the room. Maya stirs on the couch, her eyes fluttering open as the sound fills the air around her.
related_events: Call to prayer wakes Maya on the couch

name: Maya Packs in a Hurry
description: Maya throws her clothes and a wig into a suitcase in a rush, slamming it shut as if every second counts.
related_events: Maya packs clothes and wig into suitcase

name: Reporters Cover the Aftermath of the Tavistock Square Bus Explosion
description: A television screen shows file footage of a destroyed bus lying in pieces in Tavistock Square. Smoke rises from the wreckage. A reporter's voice is heard describing the scene. The camera pans across the damaged vehicle, once numbered #10, now twisted and charred. Bystanders stand behind barriers, watching in silence as emergency personnel move through the area.
related_events: Bus explodes in Tavistock Square
related_occasions: Aftermath Coverage Of The London Bus Bombing

name: Maya Arrives at the U.S. Embassy in Islamabad
description: Maya drives through the checkpoint and continues toward the main gate of the United States Embassy in Islamabad. The compound looms ahead, surrounded by high walls, armed guards, and national flags. She approaches the entrance as the vehicle slows, coming to a stop at the secure gate.
related_events: Maya drives through checkpoint to embassy gate

name: Bearded Arab Man Loads and Raises Assault Rifle
description: A bearded Arab man inserts a magazine into a black assault rifle. He then brings the weapon up to his shoulder, holding it ready.
related_events: Bearded Arab man inserts magazine into assault rifle
Bearded Arab man raises assault rifle to shoulder height

name: Interrogator Shows Photograph and Prisoner Identifies Abu Ahmed
description: In a Moroccan facility, the interrogator holds up a photograph of a bearded man to the prisoner. The interrogator asks if the man in the photo is the one. The prisoner nods and says, 'Abu Ahmed.' The interrogator brings the photograph closer to the prisoner's face, then asks again. The prisoner repeats, 'Abu Ahmed. Abu Ahmed. Abu Ahmed.'
related_events: Interrogator shows photograph of bearded man to prisoner
Prisoner identifies man in photograph as Abu Ahmed

name: Maya Enters the Military Detention Center in the Rain
description: Rain falls heavily over Islamabad, soaking the streets and turning the gutters black. Water streams down the walls of the military detention center as Maya approaches through the gates. She steps inside, her clothes damp, the weight of the storm clinging to the air around her.
related_events: Maya enters Pakistani military detention center
Rainstorm drenches city and darkens streets
related_occasions: Visit To Military Detention Center In Islamabad

name: Daniel and Guard Escort Faraj to Cell
description: Daniel walks alongside an armed guard as they lead Faraj down a corridor. Faraj is hooded and handcuffed. As they move, Daniel asks if Faraj likes Bob Marley, reggae, or Egyptian music. He says that if Faraj has a preference, he can make a call to arrange it.
related_events: Daniel and armed guard escort hooded and handcuffed Faraj to his cell
Daniel offers to play music for Faraj

name: Interrogator Shows Photo and Prisoner Identifies Abu Ahmed
description: In a Turkish prison, a Turkish interrogator shows a photograph to a prisoner. The interrogator asks if the man in the photo is one of the facilitators who met with Khalid Sheikh Mohammed. The prisoner moans, then confirms the man is Abu Ahmed.
related_events: Interrogator shows photo of facilitator to prisoner
Prisoner confirms identity of Abu Ahmed

name: Attach Bomb and Send Courier
description: A Pakistani policeman straps a bomb to the leg of a man who appears terrified. Once the bomb is secured, the policeman tells the man in Urdu, 'You know how this works? Just act naturally.' The man does not respond. The policeman then opens the door and sends him outside.
related_events: Pakistani policeman attaches bomb to man's leg
Man is sent out after bomb is attached

name: Inside the Hut with the Tribal Elders
description: A hand-held camera records five tribal elders seated on the hard floor of a stone age hut. They talk casually, sipping tea and eating as light filters through thin gaps in the walls. The camera slowly moves across their weathered faces, long beards, and worn clothing, then settles on a video recorder resting on a ledge.
related_events: Hand-held camera captures tribal elders conversing in a stone age hut
Camera pans across weathered faces of tribal elders
related_occasions: Gathering Of Tribal Elders In A Stone Age Hut

name: Maya Reviews Interrogation Footage
description: In a dimly lit research room, Maya watches multiple interrogation videos playing across several monitors. On one screen, a soldier questions a hooded prisoner seated in a grimy room with stained walls. The soldier asks about a man named Abu Ahmed from Kuwait and his ties to the leadership. The prisoner says he remembers Abu Ahmed as a nice man but claims he does not know his connections or habits. The soldier presses him, demanding more specific details. Maya pauses the video and studies the frames, comparing the prisoner’s responses with nine other ongoing interrogations displayed on her desk, searching for consistencies or clues.
related_events: Maya monitors interrogation recordings in a research room
Soldier interrogator questions prisoner about Abu Ahmed
Prisoner responds to interrogation with limited information
Maya pauses interrogation recording to analyze multiple video feeds

name: Man Shoots Five Residents in Hallway of Khobar Residential Towers
description: A man enters the hallway of the KHOBAR RESIDENTIAL TOWERS and immediately opens fire on two Western men, killing them. The sound of the shots causes other residents to scream and scramble for cover. As the man moves quickly down the hallway, he sees three more residents fleeing and shoots them, killing all three.
related_events: Man opens fire on two Western men in hallway
Residents panic after hearing gunshots
Man shoots and kills three residents fleeing in hallway

name: Maya Cleans Her Desk
description: Maya finds her desk and sees that it is covered in grime. She tries to clean it as best she can, then sits down and looks at the blank log-in screen of her computer.
related_events: Maya discovers her desk is covered in grime
Maya attempts to clean her desk

name: Maya Sits at Her Desk Facing the Log-in Screen
description: Maya finishes cleaning her desk and sits down. She looks at the blank log-in screen of her computer.
related_events: Maya sits at her desk facing a blank log-in screen

name: Interrogator Questions Mukhtar About Abu Ahmed's Whereabouts
description: In a facility in Poland, the interrogator addresses the prisoner, confirming his identity as Mukhtar, referred to as KSM's boss. The prisoner appears cold. The interrogator asks what Abu Ahmed did after Mukhtar was captured. Mukhtar responds that Abu Ahmed went to work for The Sheikh.
related_events: Interrogator identifies prisoner as KSM's boss
Prisoner confirms identity as Mukhtar with verbal exchange
Interrogator questions prisoner about Abu Ahmed's actions after capture
Prisoner states Abu Ahmed joined The Sheikh after capture

name: Bradley Secures Maya's Cooperation for a Meeting with Faraj
description: Bradley approaches Maya at her cubicle and tells her he has arranged a one-on-one meeting with Faraj. Maya expresses gratitude, but Bradley warns her not to thank him yet. He places a folder on her desk and states that he wants her to complete all the tasks inside before her next assignment. Maya agrees immediately. Bradley asks if she wants to see what’s in the folder, but Maya responds by listing intelligence topics she will cover—family ties, financial networks, media sources, disgruntled employees, imminent threats, homeland plots, foreign cells, health status, trade craft, and recruiting tactics—asking if there is anything else. Bradley walks away without answering.
related_events: Bradley offers Maya a one-on-one meeting with Faraj
Bradley delivers a folder to Maya as a condition
Maya agrees to Bradley's terms without reviewing the folder
Maya lists intelligence requirements to Bradley
Bradley walks away after receiving Maya's response

name: Daniel Stanton Enforces Obedience Through Violence
description: Daniel Stanton stands before Ammar, a prisoner standing on a worn gym mat surrounded by four guards in ski masks. Daniel, a large American with a long beard and tattoos, speaks with authority, demanding Ammar's attention. He states that if Ammar fails to look at him, if he steps off the mat, or if he lies, he will be hurt. When Ammar looks down, the guards immediately rush forward, punching and kicking him. Daniel repeats his command: "Look at me, Ammar." Throughout the assault, one of the masked guards does not join the others and remains still.
related_events: Daniel Stanton asserts control over Ammar through verbal threats
Daniel Stanton enforces eye contact as a condition of obedience
Guards assault Ammar with punches and kicks
One masked guard refrains from participating in the assault

name: Watch TV Report of Marriott Explosion
description: They move through the debris as smoke thickens around them. Their hands find each other and grip tightly. The camera cuts to a close-up of a television screen showing the ruined Marriott hotel. A reporter's voice describes a crater ten meters wide left by the blast in front of the building, as images of the destruction play silently on screen.
related_events: Television screen displays destroyed Marriott hotel
Reporter describes blast crater at Marriott hotel

name: Hold Hands Amid Smoke and Debris
description: They move through the scattered debris as the smoke grows thicker. Reaching for each other, they grasp hands tightly and continue forward together.
related_events: Characters grasp each other's hands amid intensifying smoke

name: Interrogator Questions Prisoner About Letter from bin Laden in Karachi
description: In a dimly lit prison room, an interrogator sits across from an older man chained to a desk. The two speak in Arabic, with English subtitles appearing on the screen. The interrogator asks about events in Karachi between 2003 and 2004. The prisoner confirms that during that time, someone was carrying a letter from bin Laden.
related_events: Interrogator questions prisoner about events in Karachi
Prisoner discloses carrying a letter from bin Laden

name: Maya Works Through Fatigue in the Research Room
description: Maya stays in the research room for hours, her eyes tired and her posture slumped. She continues reviewing documents and watching video footage, moving from one screen to another without pause. The room is dim, lit only by the glow of monitors, and the silence is broken only by the occasional keystroke. Despite her exhaustion, she does not stop.
related_events: Maya remains in the research room showing signs of fatigue

name: Maya and Jessica in the Late-Night Kitchen
description: Maya stands in the kitchen looking for something to eat. Jessica enters, the only other person working at this hour, and pours herself a cup of coffee. They exchange words about the challenges of their work, touching on loyalty, motivation, and the role of money. Maya smiles as she questions whether financial incentives can sway ideologically driven individuals. Jessica responds with a knowing look, suggesting that even the most committed may have their limits. Their conversation unfolds in the quiet, dimly lit kitchen, the hum of the building the only sound between them.
related_events: Maya searches for food in the kitchen
Jessica enters the kitchen and pours coffee

name: Jessica and Maya Debate Motivations Over Coffee
description: Maya is in the kitchen, grabbing something to eat. Jessica, the only other person working late, walks in and pours herself a cup of coffee. She asks Maya how the search is going, and Maya replies that it's fine. Jessica remarks that facilitators come and go, but everyone wants money in the end. Maya smiles and points out that Al Qaeda members are radicals, implying they are driven by ideology. Jessica responds with a bigger smile, suggesting that even among radicals, some might be swayed by money. Maya acknowledges that financial incentives worked during the Cold War but expresses doubt about their effectiveness in the Middle East.
related_events: Jessica comments on workplace rivalry and motivation
Jessica and Maya debate motivations of Al Qaeda members

name: Daniel and Guards Lock Faraj in Barbed Wire Cell
description: Daniel and the guards take Faraj to a cell lined with barbed wire and lock him inside. Daniel tells Faraj he is not his friend, that he is bad news, and that he will break him, saying he has done it before. Faraj dozes off, appearing weak. Daniel snaps at him to wake up and asks if he is hungry, reminding him he hasn't eaten in hours.
related_events: Guards and Daniel transport Faraj to a barbed wire-laced cell and lock him inside
Daniel declares he is not Faraj's friend and intends to break him

name: Daniel Wakes Faraj and Offers Food
description: Daniel notices Faraj dozing and calls out to wake him. He reminds him that he hasn't eaten in hours and says they need to keep his energy up. He asks if Faraj is hungry.
related_events: Daniel attempts to rouse Faraj from dozing and questions his hunger

name: Maya and Hakim Interrogate the Prisoner
description: Maya, wearing heavy makeup, walks down a narrow corridor with Hakim, a middle-aged Afghan man with thick shoulders and weary eyes. They enter a vast, cavernous hold where a prisoner is chained to a table. Hakim slides a photograph across to him. The prisoner looks at it and speaks in Arabic. Hakim listens, then translates: the prisoner says the man in the photo looks like Abu Ahmed. Maya asks who the man worked for. After a moment, Hakim translates the reply: the man worked mostly with Abu Faraj—they were always together. Maya wants to verify the prisoner’s story. She asks what the man did for Faraj. Hakim listens to the response and translates: he carried messages between Faraj and bin Laden. Maya leans in, suggesting they ask something that could confirm whether the prisoner truly knew Faraj. Hakim speaks to the prisoner, who responds. Hakim turns to Maya. 'He just told me the names of all of Faraj's children,' he says. 'I think he's telling the truth.'
related_events: Maya enters the cavernous hold with Hakim
Hakim shows photograph to chained prisoner
Prisoner responds in Arabic

name: Maya Verifies the Prisoner's Knowledge of Abu Faraj's Children
description: Maya leans toward Hakim and tells him to ask the prisoner a question to verify whether he truly knew Abu Faraj. Hakim speaks to the prisoner in Arabic. The prisoner responds, listing the names of Abu Faraj's children. Hakim turns to Maya and says, 'He just told me the names of all of Faraj's children. I think he's telling the truth.'
related_events: Maya instructs Hakim to verify prisoner's knowledge of Faraj
Prisoner confirms association with Abu Faraj through personal details
Prisoner identifies Abu Faraj's children to verify credibility

name: Daniel Feeds Monkeys Before Interrogation
description: Daniel stands in front of a makeshift cage filled with wild monkeys, eating an ice cream cone. The monkeys watch him silently, their hands gripping the wire. He offers them a piece of the ice cream, and one reaches through the bars to snatch the rest from his hand. Daniel laughs as the monkey pulls the cone away. A CIA guard approaches and says the detainee is ready. Daniel nods and turns away.
related_events: Daniel eats ice cream in front of a makeshift monkey cage
Monkeys observe Daniel from inside a wire cage

name: Daniel Feeds Monkeys, Loses Ice Cream to a Quick-Handed Monkey
description: Daniel stands in front of a makeshift cage holding wild monkeys, eating an ice cream cone. He offers a portion of it through the bars, and the monkeys watch him closely as they take it. One monkey suddenly reaches through the wire, grabs the rest of the cone, and pulls it away. Daniel looks at the monkey and laughs.
related_events: Daniel feeds monkeys a portion of his ice cream
Monkey steals remaining ice cream from Daniel through cage bars

name: CIA Guard Interrupts Daniel with Detainee Update
description: Daniel stands eating an ice cream cone in front of a makeshift cage filled with monkeys. He offers them a piece of the ice cream, watching as they reach through the bars. A CIA Guard approaches and tells him the detainee is ready. Daniel nods, weary. As the guard walks away, a monkey snatches the rest of the ice cream from his hand. Daniel looks at the monkey and laughs.
related_events: CIA Guard informs Daniel about the detainee's readiness

name: Interrogation of Hassan Ghul
description: Hassan Ghul sits manacled to a desk. Maya tells him she had him captured instead of killed because he is not a violent man. Ghul thanks her. Maya warns that he may be sent to Israel, but if he cooperates, he might stay in Pakistan. Ghul, visibly uneasy, says he does not want to be tortured and invites her to ask questions. Maya asks about Atiyah Abd al-Rahman. Ghul says he works for Zawahiri and oversees military tactics. Maya asks if he has heard of Abu Ahmed. Ghul replies that Abu Ahmed works for Faraj and bin Laden and is the Sheikh’s most trusted courier. Maya tries to conceal her reaction but shows a hint of satisfaction. She presses for more, asking where she can find Abu Ahmed. Ghul says no one can find him, not even himself. He explains that Abu Ahmed always contacted him unexpectedly and is one of the disappeared ones.
related_events: Maya interrogates Hassan Ghul about Al Qaeda ties
Hassan Ghul reveals Atiyah Abd al-Rahman's role in Al Qaeda

name: Maya Interrogates Ghul About Bin Laden's Courier
description: Hassan Ghul, seated manacled at a desk, tells Maya that Abu Ahmed is one of bin Laden's most trusted couriers, working directly for Faraj and bin Laden. Ghul explains that Abu Ahmed delivered messages from the Sheikh to him personally. Maya listens closely, her expression briefly revealing a flash of satisfaction before she composes herself. She presses Ghul for more details, asking where he last saw the courier and where he might be now. Ghul responds that no one can find him—that Abu Ahmed always appeared without warning and was one of the disappeared ones.
related_events: Hassan Ghul identifies Abu Ahmed as bin Laden's trusted courier
Maya reacts to confirmation about bin Laden's courier

name: Ghul Reveals the Courier's Disappearance
description: Maya questions Hassan Ghul about the whereabouts of Abu Ahmed, pressing for details on his location. Ghul responds that he cannot provide an answer, explaining that he never initiated contact with the courier. Abu Ahmed always reached out unexpectedly, never leaving a trace. Ghul emphasizes that even he was unable to find him, describing him as one of 'the disappeared ones.' Maya listens intently, her expression revealing a flicker of satisfaction before she composes herself.
related_events: Hassan Ghul explains lack of contact with Abu Ahmed

name: Maya Interrogates Faraj About Bin Laden's Courier
description: Maya questions Faraj about Abu Ahmed, pressing him on claims that he was bin Laden's courier. Faraj responds that they are mistaken and says the real courier is Al Buluchi, whom he describes as tall, thin, with a long white beard and a cane. Maya expresses disbelief, noting she has never heard of this man. She asks what he looks like, comparing him to a character Faraj does not recognize. Faraj says he last saw Al Buluchi a month earlier in Karachi, and that they often exchanged messages without meeting in person. Maya tells him she does not believe his story. A guard in the room slaps Faraj across the face. Faraj shows no reaction. Maya remains expressionless. She tells him he is not being fully cooperative. The guard strikes him again. Faraj stays impassive.
related_events: Maya questions Faraj about Abu Ahmed's identity and connection to bin Laden
Faraj corrects Maya by identifying Al Buluchi as bin Laden's actual courier
Maya expresses skepticism about Faraj's account of Al Buluchi

name: Maya Questions Faraj About Al Buluchi's Appearance and Where He Was Last Seen
description: Maya presses Faraj for details about Al Buluchi, asking what the man looks like. Faraj describes him as tall, thin, with a long white beard and a cane. Maya compares his appearance to Gandalf, a figure Faraj does not recognize. She asks when and where Faraj last saw him. Faraj replies that it was a month ago in Karachi. He adds that he sometimes did not see Al Buluchi at all, as the man would only tell him where to leave messages.
related_events: Faraj describes Al Buluchi's physical appearance and communication methods
Maya references Gandalf to illustrate Al Buluchi's described appearance
Faraj reveals last sighting of Al Buluchi in Karachi one month prior

name: Maya Challenges Faraj, Guard Uses Force
description: Maya listens to Faraj’s answers and tells him she doesn’t believe him. She accuses him of not being fully truthful. As she speaks, the guard in the room moves forward and slaps Faraj across the face. Faraj shows no reaction. Maya remains still, her expression unchanged. The guard strikes Faraj again, but Faraj stays silent and composed, his face impassive.
related_events: Maya expresses disbelief in Faraj's responses
Guard slaps Faraj during interrogation
Faraj maintains composure after being slapped

name: Interrogation in Yemeni Prison
description: In a dimly lit room inside a Yemeni prison, Interrogator Abu Ahmed leans forward and asks the prisoner if a certain man is the courier for bin Laden. The prisoner hesitates, then replies that no one can be sure who works directly for bin Laden, but suggests the man might be part of the network. Abu Ahmed presses further, asking if others also carried messages for bin Laden. The prisoner nods and says there were four or five others. As Abu Ahmed begins to ask about them, the prisoner pauses, lost in thought. The camera holds on the screen as Maya watches silently, motionless.
related_events: Interrogator questions prisoner about bin Laden's courier
Prisoner acknowledges uncertainty about bin Laden's direct associates

name: Interrogator Presses Prisoner for Names of Al-Qaeda Couriers
description: In a dimly lit room inside a Yemeni prison, the interrogator, Abu Ahmed, leans forward. The prisoner sits slumped, silent for a moment. 'Were there other people who carried messages from bin Laden?' Abu Ahmed asks. The prisoner lifts his head slightly. 'Sure,' he says. The interrogator waits. The prisoner pauses, thinking. 'Four or five,' he replies. 'Let's talk about them,' Abu Ahmed says, but before the prisoner can respond, the image freezes. Maya stares at the screen.
related_events: Interrogator inquires about other message carriers for bin Laden
Prisoner confirms existence of multiple message carriers
Interrogator attempts to discuss other message carriers

name: Maya Watches the Frozen Interrogation Screen
description: The video feed from the interrogation in the Yemeni prison suddenly freezes. Maya stands motionless, her eyes fixed on the paused image. The room is silent as she stares at the screen, the last words from the prisoner hanging in the air.
related_events: Video image freezes during interrogation
Maya stares at frozen interrogation screen

name: Faraj Enters the Park and Approaches the Courier
description: Abu Faraj appears at the south end of the park and begins walking toward his courier. As he moves through the open space, he scans his surroundings: children play nearby, several figures in black burkhas stand scattered across the area, and the sun shines brightly overhead. The courier, having passed the playing children, continues through the park. From a nearby tower, Daniel watches silently. Faraj reaches an open area where he and the courier can see each other. They exchange a brief, nervous glance. Faraj turns to flee, but the figures in black burkhas close in on him quickly. They seize him, revealing themselves as armed Pakistani agents. Daniel continues to observe from above as Faraj is captured.
related_events: Abu Faraj appears at the south end of the park
Faraj's courier walks past playing children
Faraj observes surroundings including playing children and people in black burkhas

name: Faraj and the Courier's Failed Escape
description: Faraj approaches the open area and sees his courier. They lock eyes, both pausing briefly, their expressions tense. Without a word, Faraj turns and begins to run. From all sides, figures in black burkhas close in rapidly. He is overtaken before he can get far. Above, Daniel watches from the tower as Faraj is seized.
related_events: Faraj and his courier meet face to face in an open area
Faraj and his courier exchange a nervous glance signaling a trap
Faraj attempts to flee after realizing the danger

name: Pakistani Agents Capture Faraj While Daniel Watches
description: Faraj walks through the park, passing playing children and several figures in black burkhas. He approaches an open area where his courier stands. They exchange a brief, uneasy glance before Faraj turns to flee. The figures in burkhas rush forward, surrounding and seizing him. They are heavily armed Pakistani agents. From a nearby tower, Daniel watches as Faraj is taken into custody.
related_events: Pakistani agents in black burkhas surround and capture Abu Faraj
Daniel observes Faraj's capture from a nearby tower

name: Bradley and Daniel Discuss the Operation
description: Joseph Bradley walks down the lobby staircase with Daniel, asking how the recent operation went. Daniel says it went well—the target is a Tier One asset, a major breakthrough, though the local police need tactical support. Bradley asks if the suspect is KSM's nephew and what kind of resistance he's showing. Daniel confirms the man is being difficult and uncooperative.
related_events: Joseph Bradley and Daniel descend the lobby staircase together
Joseph Bradley asks Daniel about the recent operation
Daniel reports success of the operation to Joseph Bradley
Joseph Bradley asks Daniel about the suspect's identity and behavior
Daniel reports that the suspect is being uncooperative

name: Bradley Advises Daniel to Use His PhD in Interrogation
description: Descending the lobby staircase, Joseph Bradley asks Daniel how the recent interrogation went. Daniel says it was good—the local police need tactical support, but the target is Tier One, the real prize. Bradley asks if the suspect is KSM's nephew and what the problem is. Daniel replies that the man is being difficult. As they walk through the lobby, Bradley suggests Daniel use his PhD to assert dominance if the detainee tries to outthink him. Daniel nods, acknowledging he will need to turn up the pressure to get the man to talk about the Saudi group. They approach the holding area where Maya sits waiting.
related_events: Joseph Bradley advises Daniel to use his PhD to assert authority
Daniel decides to increase pressure on the suspect

name: Bradley and Daniel Approach Maya in the Holding Area
description: Joseph Bradley and Daniel descend the lobby staircase, continuing their conversation about the interrogation. Daniel mentions the local police need tactical support, but the target is high-value—the real prize. Bradley asks if the suspect is KSM's nephew and what his problem is. Daniel says the man is being difficult. Bradley suggests Daniel use his PhD to assert dominance if the detainee tries to outthink him. Daniel agrees he’ll need to increase the pressure to get information about the Saudi group. As they reach the lobby, they see Maya sitting in the holding area. They walk toward her, Bradley considering what Daniel has requested.
related_events: Joseph Bradley and Daniel approach Maya in the holding area

name: Maya presents detainee intelligence on Abu Ahmed to Bradley
description: Maya stands in Bradley's office and presents intelligence gathered from detainees about a man known as Abu Ahmed. She explains that twenty detainees have identified him, saying he was part of a close group in Afghanistan before 9/11. After the attacks, they claim he began working for KSM, and when KSM was captured, he became a courier for Abu Faraj, delivering messages to bin Laden. Bradley listens with his feet up on his desk, holding a photograph of Abu Ahmed. He acknowledges the information but points out that they do not know Abu Ahmed’s real name or his location. Maya argues that the fact so many detainees recognize him but refuse to disclose his whereabouts suggests he is important. Bradley remains skeptical, suggesting the detainees might not know or could be fabricating the figure. Daniel, sitting on the couch, mutters that they don’t know what they don’t know, drawing a sharp response from Bradley. Jessica sits perched on the arm of the couch, silent and observant. Bradley concedes the work is solid but tells Maya to return when she has actionable intelligence that could lead to a strike.
related_events: Maya pitches intelligence findings to Bradley in his office
Maya reports detainee identifications of Abu Ahmed
Maya details Abu Ahmed's alleged courier role after KSM's capture
Maya infers Abu Ahmed's importance from secrecy surrounding him

name: Bradley Presses Maya on Abu Ahmed's Identity and Location
description: Bradley sits with his feet propped on his desk, holding The Photograph, as Maya stands and presents her findings. She says twenty detainees recognize the photo of Abu Ahmed and place him within the inner circle in Afghanistan before 9/11. They claim he later worked for KSM and then became a courier for Abu Faraj, possibly delivering messages to bin Laden. Bradley interrupts, acknowledging the information but pressing Maya on the absence of Abu Ahmed’s real name and any knowledge of his whereabouts. He questions whether the detainees’ silence means Abu Ahmed is important or if they simply don’t know. Maya admits the uncertainty. Daniel mutters that they don’t know what they don’t know, drawing a sharp retort from Bradley. Bradley turns back to Maya, emphasizing that no detainee has linked Abu Ahmed directly to bin Laden’s location—only to message delivery. He concedes it’s good work but tells her to return when she has actionable intelligence that could lead to a strike.
related_events: Bradley challenges Maya's intelligence gaps
Bradley questions the significance of detainee silence on Abu Ahmed's location

name: Daniel's Tautology
description: Maya stands in Bradley's office, laying out what the detainees have said about Abu Ahmed—his connections to KSM, his role as a courier for Abu Faraj, possibly for bin Laden. Bradley leans back with his feet on the desk, skeptical. He points out they don’t know Abu Ahmed’s real name or his location. Maya insists the fact that no one will reveal his whereabouts suggests his importance. Bradley counters that silence doesn’t confirm anything. Daniel, slouched on the couch, mutters, 'We don't know what we don't know.' Bradley turns to him, irritated. 'What the fuck is that supposed to mean?' Daniel replies, 'It's a tautology.' Bradley dismisses the comment and returns to Maya, acknowledging her work but demanding actionable intelligence that could lead to a strike.
related_events: Daniel comments on the uncertainty of unknown intelligence

name: Bradley Ends Meeting with Demand for Actionable Intel
description: Maya stands in Bradley's office presenting information about Abu Ahmed, explaining that twenty detainees recognize him as part of an inner circle in Afghanistan before 9/11 and later as a courier between key figures after KSM's capture. Bradley listens with his feet up on the desk, holding The Photograph. Daniel sits slouched on the couch, Jessica perched on its arm, legs crossed. Bradley interrupts, pointing out they don’t know Abu Ahmed’s real name or his location, and questions whether the detainee accounts are reliable. Maya argues that the fact no one will reveal his whereabouts suggests his importance. Bradley counters that silence doesn’t prove significance and notes no detainee has placed Abu Ahmed directly with bin Laden. Daniel mutters, “We don’t know what we don’t know,” prompting Bradley to snap at him before turning back to Maya. He acknowledges the work but insists on actionable intelligence—something that could lead to a strike. He ends the conversation with that directive and the meeting concludes.
related_events: Bradley demands actionable intelligence leading to a strike

name: Maya Confronts Police at Checkpoint
description: The car stops at a checkpoint guarded by Pakistani police. An officer walks up, shines a bright light into Maya's eyes, and motions for her to lower her window. She keeps it closed. He asks where she is going. She says, 'To the Marriott. I assume you noticed the dip plates.' The officer hesitates, then points to a duffel bag on the rear seat. She replies, 'It's a gym bag,' and refuses to get out of the car. The officer moves closer. Maya rolls up her window, locks the door, and starts dialing her phone. He steps back to speak with the other officers. They gather in a group, talking quietly. Moments later, the officer returns with several more policemen. Together, they approach the car and knock sharply on the window. Maya does not move or look away. She stares straight ahead.
related_events: Pakistani police officer shines light into Maya's eyes at checkpoint
Maya refuses to roll down window and identifies diplomatic plates
Policeman questions presence of duffel bag in rear seat
Maya identifies bag as gym bag and refuses to exit vehicle

name: Maya Locks Down the Car and Dials Her Phone
description: When the policeman moves closer after she refuses to exit the vehicle, Maya rolls up her window, presses the door lock, and starts dialing her cell phone. The officers step back and gather together, speaking quietly. After a moment, the original officer returns with several others. They approach the car in unison and knock sharply on the window, but Maya does not move or look away.
related_events: Maya rolls up window, locks door, and begins dialing phone

name: Officers Confer and Confront Maya at Checkpoint
description: After Maya rolled up her window and locked the doors, the policeman stepped back to speak with the other officers. They gathered in a tight group, talking quietly. A moment later, he returned with several additional officers. Together, they approached the car and knocked sharply and repeatedly on the window.
related_events: Police officers huddle to consult after Maya's resistance
Multiple officers approach car and knock insistently on window

name: Maya Faces Down the Police at the Checkpoint
description: The officers surround the car and knock sharply on the window, their voices raised and movements insistent. Maya does not move. She keeps her eyes forward, her hands still on the wheel, her expression unchanged. The bright lights sweep across the windshield, but she does not blink or turn her head. The knocking continues, hard and repeated, but she gives no response.
related_events: Maya remains motionless and unresponsive under pressure

name: Maya Arrives at the Facility
description: Daniel speaks with Bradley, who agrees to allow Maya entry. Daniel knocks on the glass partition, signaling for her to come in. A guard opens the door and Maya walks through. Daniel introduces her to Bradley, explaining they served together in Iraq. Bradley greets her and shakes her hand. They begin walking down the lobby toward the Secure Wing, making small talk about her flight and her thoughts on Pakistan. Bradley directs her to the third floor, northeast corner. He checks her through an electronic door and watches with Daniel as she walks away.
related_events: Daniel receives permission from Bradley to bring Maya in
Daniel calls Maya into the room by knocking on the glass
Daniel introduces Maya to Joseph Bradley

name: Bradley and Daniel Evaluate Maya's Assignment
description: Bradley greets Maya after her arrival and asks about her flight and her thoughts on Pakistan. She replies that her flight was fine but adds that Pakistan is kinda fucked up. When Bradley asks if she volunteered for the assignment, she says no, and he smiles, already knowing the answer. He escorts her through a secure electronic door, then tells Daniel that Washington considers her a killer, affirming her readiness for high-stakes work. Daniel comments that she seems young for such assignments, and Bradley responds that they want the next generation on the field. Maya walks down the hall and heads to the third floor, northeast corner, while Daniel and Bradley watch her go.
related_events: Bradley questions Maya about her flight and experience in Pakistan
Bradley confirms Maya did not volunteer for the assignment
Bradley escorts Maya through a secure electronic door
Maya walks away toward the third floor northeast corner
Bradley states that Washington considers Maya highly capable
Bradley mentions the strategic push to deploy the next generation of operatives

name: Bradley and Daniel Discuss ISI Delays and Missing Intelligence
description: After Maya walks away, Daniel voices concern about the lack of progress from ISI in Lahore. Bradley mentions he has a meeting with them in twenty minutes and asks if Daniel has seen a cable from London. Daniel replies that he’s been stuck in a dark room with another man for the past two days and hasn’t had access to any recent updates.
related_events: Daniel expresses concern about Maya's readiness for intense operations
Daniel criticizes ISI's cooperation in Lahore
Bradley announces his upcoming meeting with ISI
Bradley asks Daniel about a cable from London
Daniel explains his lack of access to recent intelligence

name: Blame and Reckoning After the Massacre
description: News footage of the massacre plays on CU TV. Daniel, Jessica, and Maya watch in silence. Daniel turns to Jessica, his voice heavy. He says the Saudis didn't listen, and now it's too late. He blames himself, then points at Maya, saying Ammar is on him—and on her. Jessica tells him he warned them, but they didn't take him seriously. She says he had only days and an unresponsive ally, and that he needs to look ahead—to London, to Heathrow, where the threat remains active. Maya insists Ammar doesn't know what happened. Jessica replies that those close to KSM are devious. Maya argues Ammar won't reveal attacks on the homeland or details about the network. But then she pauses, flips her thinking: Ammar has been isolated, hasn't slept, doesn't know they failed. They can tell him anything. Daniel asks if she means bluffing him. She doesn't answer. The screen cuts to black.
related_events: News footage reveals massacre despite intervention efforts
Daniel blames himself and Maya for AQ's success
Jessica reassures Daniel about the failed prevention

name: Jessica and Maya Debate Ammar's Awareness
description: Jessica and Maya stand together, watching news footage of the massacre. Jessica insists Ammar knows about the attack because of his ties to KSM’s circle. Maya argues he has no way of knowing, having been held in complete isolation. Jessica warns that people close to KSM are devious and can’t be trusted. Maya points out that Ammar hasn’t slept and remains unaware of the outcome, suggesting they could use that to their advantage.
related_events: Jessica reveals Ammar's knowledge of the operation
Maya asserts Ammar's lack of awareness about the failed operation
Jessica warns Maya about the deceptiveness of KSM's associates

name: Maya Suggests Bluffing Ammar During Interrogation
description: Maya flips through notes, then looks up sharply. She points out that Ammar has been in complete isolation and hasn't slept. He doesn't know the attack in Saudi Arabia already happened. Daniel asks if they're going to bluff him. Jessica adds that people close to KSM are devious and must be handled carefully. Maya insists Ammar will withhold details about attacks on the homeland and any information on bin Laden. But because he’s cut off and exhausted, they can tell him anything. Daniel stares, considering the idea.
related_events: Maya proposes exploiting Ammar's isolation to manipulate his perception
Maya predicts Ammar will withhold critical intelligence
Maya emphasizes Ammar's physical and mental vulnerability due to sleep deprivation
Daniel questions the use of deception to extract information from Ammar

name: Jessica Shifts Focus to Heathrow Threat
description: Jessica turns to Daniel and Maya after news of the massacre plays on CU TV. She tells Daniel the Saudis will handle the aftermath, but the real priority is what comes next. Daniel blames himself and Ammar, pointing at Maya as partly responsible. Jessica insists the failure isn't on him, reminding him they had only days and an uncooperative ally. She brings up London and Heathrow, stressing that the plot for mass casualties is still active. Maya argues Ammar has no knowledge of the failed attack, having been in isolation. Jessica warns that people close to KSM are deceptive. Maya adds that Ammar won’t reveal operational details about attacks on the homeland or the KSM network, but since he’s been cut off from information, they can manipulate what he knows. Daniel asks if they should bluff him. Maya confirms—he’s exhausted, isolated, and completely unaware of the current situation.
related_events: Jessica redirects focus to active threat at Heathrow

name: Maya Revealed After Interrogation
description: Daniel and two masked figures step out of the interrogation room into the daylight. One of the figures pulls off the mask, revealing a young woman with pale skin, bright blue eyes, and a slender frame. Her name is Maya. She stands quietly as Daniel speaks to a guard about boarding up the windows. He offers her a cup of coffee, but she declines, saying they should go back in. Daniel hesitates, then agrees. Before re-entering, he hands her the ski mask. She looks at him and asks if the prisoner will ever get out. Daniel says no.
related_events: Daniel and masked figures exit interrogation room into daylight
Masked woman reveals identity as Maya

name: Daniel and Maya After the Interrogation
description: Daniel and Maya step out of the interrogation room into the daylight. They remove their masks, revealing Maya’s pale, delicate features and bright blue eyes. Daniel speaks to a guard about boarding up the windows, then turns to Maya. He tells her that it’s not always this intense, noting she just arrived from Washington and went straight into her first interrogation. Maya says she’s fine. Daniel observes her and replies that it will take time, that the prisoner must learn his helplessness, then suggests they get coffee. Maya refuses, saying they should go back in. Daniel, noticing the intensity in her expression, changes his mind and turns back toward the room. He offers her the ski mask again, but she asks why he isn’t wearing one and whether the prisoner will ever be released. Daniel answers, 'Never.'
related_events: Daniel comments on intensity of first interrogation
Maya responds to Daniel with visible distress
Daniel suggests getting coffee while interrogation continues

name: Maya Returns to the Interrogation Room
description: Daniel suggests getting coffee and stepping away from the interrogation, but Maya insists on going back in. Her expression is intense, focused, and unyielding. Daniel hesitates, then changes his mind about leaving. At the door, he hands her the ski mask and tells her she might want to put it on. She looks at him and asks if the prisoner will ever get out. Daniel says no.
related_events: Maya insists on returning to interrogation room despite tension
Daniel reconsider decision to leave due to Maya's intense expression
Daniel offers ski mask to Maya at interrogation room door

name: Maya Asks About the Prisoner's Fate
description: As they stand outside the interrogation room, Maya turns to Daniel and asks if the prisoner will ever get out. Daniel looks at her and says, 'Never.'
related_events: Maya questions Daniel about prisoner's future release

name: Maya and Daniel at the Monkey Cage
description: Maya walks through the quiet facility at night and finds Daniel standing by the empty monkey cage. They exchange words about Abu Ahmed, with Maya insisting he knows nothing despite their efforts. Daniel refuses an offer to interrogate him, saying he’s leaving the facility soon. He jokes about having seen too many naked men and wants to go to Washington to try something different. He invites Maya to join him, but she declines, saying she can’t find Abu Ahmed from D.C. They both look at the empty cage. Daniel says the monkeys were killed after an escape attempt. Maya apologizes. Daniel warns her about the changing politics around detainees and tells her to be careful when she returns to Pakistan, because everyone knows her now.
related_events: Maya encounters Daniel at the monkey cage during a nighttime walk

name: Maya and Daniel Discuss Faraj's Interrogation
description: Maya walks through the quiet facility and finds Daniel near the monkey cage, which is empty. She tells him that Faraj is still denying any knowledge of Abu Ahmed, no matter what they do. Daniel replies that Faraj will either stay silent or break from the pressure. Maya asks if Daniel wants to take over the interrogation. He says no. She seems surprised. He tells her he’s planning to leave, maybe go to Washington and try something different. He invites her to come with him, says she should be his number two. Maya refuses, saying she can’t find Abu Ahmed from D.C. They both look at the empty cage. Daniel says the monkeys are dead—something about an escape. Maya apologizes. Daniel warns her to be careful with detainees now, because the political situation is shifting. He tells her to watch her back when she returns to Pakistan, since everyone knows her there.
related_events: Maya reports Faraj's denial of knowing Abu Ahmed
Maya offers Daniel the opportunity to interrogate Abu Ahmed

name: Daniel Announces He's Leaving for Washington
description: Maya walks through the quiet facility and finds Daniel by the empty monkey cage. He tells her he’s leaving, that he’s seen too many men naked, more than a hundred, and needs to do something normal for a while. He says he’s going to Washington, to take part in the political process there, and asks Maya to come with him, to be his number two. He notes she looks worn out. Maya refuses, saying she won’t find Abu Ahmed in D.C. They both look at the empty cage. Daniel says they killed his monkeys, something about an escape. He warns her to be careful with detainees now, that the politics are shifting, and she doesn’t want to be the last one holding a dog collar when oversight arrives. He also tells her to watch her back in Pakistan—everyone knows her now.
related_events: Daniel expresses intent to leave the facility
Daniel suggests moving to Washington and invites Maya to join him

name: Maya and Daniel at the Empty Monkey Cage
description: Maya walks through the quiet facility and finds Daniel standing by the monkey cage, which is empty. Daniel tells her the monkeys were killed because of an escape. Maya looks at him, seeing how much he has changed, and does not hide her disappointment. They both stare at the empty cage in silence.
related_events: Maya expresses disappointment in Daniel's current state
Daniel reveals the monkeys were killed due to an escape

name: Daniel Warns Maya of Political and Personal Dangers
description: Maya walks through the quiet facility and finds Daniel by the empty monkey cage. They talk about Abu Ahmed, and Maya insists he will break under pressure. Daniel refuses her offer to take over the interrogation, saying he’s leaving the facility. He plans to go to Washington to try a different life, and suggests Maya join him, noting she looks worn down. Maya declines, saying she can’t find Abu Ahmed from D.C. Daniel points out the empty cage, telling her the monkeys were killed after an escape attempt. He warns her that the rules around detainee treatment are shifting, and she should be careful not to be the last one applying harsh methods when oversight arrives. He also tells her to watch her back in Pakistan, because people there now know who she is.
related_events: Daniel warns Maya about changing detainee policies and oversight risks
Daniel advises Maya to be cautious in Pakistan due to her known presence

name: Maya and Jessica at the Marriott Hotel in Islamabad
description: Maya enters the room at the Marriott Hotel in Islamabad, visibly flustered, muttering about checkpoints. She sits down and immediately focuses on her Blackberry. Jessica calls her name, reminding her they are supposed to be socializing. Maya reluctantly puts the device away. Jessica presses her to let go of her fixation on Abu Ahmed, suggesting it's time to move on, especially since Faraj has disappeared. Maya insists she can handle multiple leads and argues that Faraj’s lie about Abu Ahmed is significant—he only lied about one other person, bin Laden. Jessica challenges her, saying this could just be confirmation bias, and expresses concern. Maya rubs her eyes, forcing a smile. Jessica asks where Jack is, and Maya says he’s probably stuck at a checkpoint. Jessica teases her about Jack, asking if they’ve gotten involved. Maya dismisses the idea, saying she’s not that kind of person. Jessica points out she has no boyfriend and questions whether she has any friends at all. Before Maya can respond, Jessica’s phone rings—it’s Jack. She answers, saying it’s okay, when suddenly an explosion tears through the restaurant, shattering windows, overturning tables, and plunging the room into smoke and chaos. Maya struggles to her feet, grabs Jessica, and pulls her toward safety as alarms blare.
related_events: Maya arrives late and expresses frustration about checkpoints
Jessica urges Maya to be more socially engaged
Meeting At Marriott Hotel In Islamabad
related_occasions: Meeting At Marriott Hotel In Islamabad

name: Jessica and Maya Argue Over the Abu Ahmed Lead in Islamabad
description: Jessica sits across from Maya at a table in a well-furnished room inside a Marriott hotel in Islamabad. Maya enters, flustered, complaining about checkpoints, and immediately focuses on her Blackberry. Jessica urges her to be present, reminding her they are supposed to be socializing. Maya reluctantly puts the device away. Jessica presses Maya to let go of her focus on Abu Ahmed, pointing out that Faraj has proven unreliable and that other threats remain active in London and Spain. Maya insists she can pursue Abu Ahmed while monitoring other cells, adding that Faraj’s lie about Abu Ahmed is significant—he only withheld information on one other person: bin Laden. She takes this as proof of Abu Ahmed’s importance. Jessica calls it confirmation bias and expresses concern for Maya, saying they’re all worried about her. Maya rubs her eyes and forces a smile. Jessica asks where Jack is, then jokes about whether Maya and Jack have become involved. Maya dismisses the idea, saying she’s not that kind of person. Jessica persists, asking if Maya has any friends at all. Before Maya can answer, Jessica’s phone rings—it’s Jack. She answers, saying it’s okay, but suddenly an explosion tears through the restaurant, shattering windows, overturning tables, and plunging the room into smoke and chaos. Alarms blare as Maya struggles to her feet, grabs Jessica, and pulls her toward safety.
related_events: Jessica challenges Maya's fixation on Abu Ahmed
Maya defends her continued pursuit of the Abu Ahmed lead
Jessica accuses Maya of confirmation bias

name: Jessica Questions Maya About Jack and Her Personal Life
description: Jessica and Maya sit together at a table in a restaurant at the Marriott Hotel in Islamabad. After exchanging words about their work, Jessica asks where Jack is. Maya replies that he’s probably stuck at a checkpoint. Jessica teases her, asking if the two of them have started a romantic relationship. Maya responds sharply, saying she’s not that kind of person and that such behavior would be unbecoming. Jessica persists, suggesting that a little romance might do her good, then asks if Maya has any friends at all. Maya doesn’t answer. The moment lingers, tense and quiet, until Jessica’s phone rings. She answers and says, 'Hey — that’s okay —' and then an explosion tears through the restaurant, shattering windows, overturning tables, and plunging the room into smoke and chaos.

Jessica questions Maya's lack of personal relationships and social connections

name: Maya and Jessica Survive Restaurant Explosion
description: Jessica answers her phone as Jack's name appears on the screen. Mid-sentence, a deafening explosion rips through the restaurant. Windows shatter, tables and lights are destroyed, and people are thrown violently to the ground. Smoke fills the air as alarms begin to wail. Maya struggles to her feet, grabs Jessica by the arm, and pulls her through the wreckage toward safety.
related_events: Jessica receives a phone call from Jack
Explosion destroys restaurant and injures occupants
Maya helps Jessica escape the damaged restaurant after the explosion
related_occasions: Meeting At Marriott Hotel In Islamabad

name: Ammar Brought to the Picnic Table
description: Guards lead Ammar to a picnic table where Daniel and Maya are seated among an array of Arabic food. They remove his hood, revealing his weakened state. He stares at the table without recognition. Daniel speaks calmly, telling him that short-term memory loss is a side effect of sleep deprivation and assures him his memory should return. Maya adds that after 96 hours without sleep, he had previously given them names of associates, information that saved innocent lives. Ammar responds weakly, unsure of what to remember. The food sits untouched as the moment settles.
related_events: Guards bring prisoner Ammar to the picnic table and remove his hood
Daniel explains short-term memory loss as a side effect of sleep deprivation
Maya informs Ammar about his prior cooperation under sleep deprivation

name: Ammar Eats the Meal and Resumes Talking
description: Daniel and Maya sit with Ammar at a picnic table laden with Arabic food. After being kept awake for 96 hours, Ammar is disoriented but drawn to the meal. Daniel urges him to eat, telling him he's earned it. Ammar hesitates, then begins eating. As he consumes the food, Daniel resumes questioning, asking about Ammar's travels and activities after 9/11. Ammar responds, recounting his attempt to reach Tora Bora and naming associates from that time. Maya takes notes, pressing for details about one of the men—Abu Ahmed al-Kuwaiti. Ammar insists he does not know the man’s family name. He recalls seeing him in Karachi about a year earlier, where the man read a letter attributed to bin Laden. Daniel offers Ammar a cigarette, lights it for him, and the questioning continues.
related_events: Ammar begins eating the food provided at the table

name: Daniel Questions Ammar About His Travel and Associates
description: Daniel sits with Maya at a picnic table laden with Arabic food, watching as guards bring in Ammar and remove his hood. Ammar stares weakly at the table. Maya reminds him that after 96 hours without sleep, he provided names that saved innocent lives. Daniel urges him to eat, and Ammar begins to eat the food. Daniel asks if Ammar flew through Amman to Kabul to visit his uncle Mukhtar. Ammar is surprised, and Daniel explains he has access to flight manifests. Daniel sympathizes, acknowledging how difficult things must have been after 9/11, and asks what Ammar did between the U.S. invasion and his return to Peshawar. Ammar says he chose to fight, wanting to kill Americans, but couldn’t reach Tora Bora due to heavy bombing. Maya asks who he means by 'we.' Ammar names Hamza Rabia, Khabab al-Masri, and Abu Ahmed. Maya presses for more details about Abu Ahmed, noting the name is a kunya. Ammar insists he doesn’t know the man’s family name, explaining it wasn’t something asked under his uncle’s circle. He adds that Abu Ahmed was a computer specialist who went north to Kunar after Tora Bora. Ammar recalls seeing him once in Karachi about a year earlier, where he read a letter aloud from the Sheikh. Daniel offers Ammar a cigarette, lights it for him, and asks what the letter said. Ammar replies, 'Continue the jihad. The work will go on for a hundred years.'
related_events: Daniel questions Ammar about his travel route to Kabul and connection to Mukhtar
Ammar identifies Hamza Rabia, Khabab al-Masri, and Abu Ahmed as his associates

name: Maya Presses Ammar for Details About Abu Ahmed
description: Maya questions Ammar about Abu Ahmed, a man he mentioned during interrogation. Ammar describes him as a computer specialist who was with him and others after the failed attempt to reach Tora Bora, and says he last saw him in Karachi about a year earlier. He provides the name Abu Ahmed al-Kuwaiti, explaining it is a kunya, and insists he does not know the man’s family name, saying such information was never shared under his uncle’s circle. Maya notes that 'Abu Ahmed' means 'father of Ahmed' and points out that it is a kunya, not a personal name, underscoring the lack of specific details.
related_events: Maya questions the identity of Abu Ahmed
Ammar provides Abu Ahmed's kunya as Abu Ahmed al-Kuwaiti
Ammar claims ignorance of Abu Ahmed's family name

name: Ammar Reveals Abu Ahmed's Role in Bin Laden's Network
description: Ammar tells Daniel and Maya that his uncle had informed him Abu Ahmed worked for bin Laden. He recalls seeing Abu Ahmed about a year earlier in Karachi, where he read a letter from the Sheikh to their group. The letter stated, "Continue the jihad. The work will go on for a hundred years." Daniel offers Ammar a cigarette. Ammar accepts, and Daniel lights it for him.
related_events: Ammar reveals Abu Ahmed worked for bin Laden and read a letter from him
Daniel offers Ammar a cigarette and lights it for him

name: Ammar Recounts bin Laden's Letter
description: Ammar sits at the picnic table, smoking a cigarette offered by Daniel. He recalls a moment from about a year earlier in Karachi, where he saw Abu Ahmed al-Kuwaiti again. Abu Ahmed had read aloud a letter attributed to the Sheikh. Ammar repeats the words: "Continue the jihad. The work will go on for a hundred years." Daniel and Maya listen without comment as Ammar speaks.
related_events: Ammar recounts the content of bin Laden's letter

name: Daniel Questions Ammar About His Past After 9/11
description: Daniel sits with Ammar at a picnic table laden with Arabic food, acknowledging how difficult things must have been after 9/11. He asks Ammar what he did between the U.S. invasion and his return to Peshawar. Ammar looks at him directly and says he wanted to kill Americans. He explains that he and a group of men tried to reach Tora Bora, but the bombing was too intense, and they couldn't make it across. Daniel nods, understanding, and confirms that Ammar chose to fight. Maya listens and takes notes as the conversation continues.
related_events: Daniel acknowledges post-9/11 difficulties and asks about Ammar's activities before returning to Pesh
Ammar reveals his intention to kill Americans after 9/11

name: Maya Questions Ammar About the Men He Fought With
description: Ammar says he and others tried to reach Tora Bora after 9/11 but were stopped by heavy bombing. When he mentions 'we,' Maya asks who exactly he means. Ammar names Hamza Rabia, Khabab al-Masri, and Abu Ahmed. Maya presses for more details about Abu Ahmed, asking for his family name. Ammar explains that Abu Ahmed al-Kuwaiti was a computer specialist who went north to Kunar after Tora Bora. Maya points out that 'Abu Ahmed' is a kunya, not a family name, and Ammar insists he does not know the man’s full name. He adds that his uncle told him the man worked for bin Laden and that he saw him once in Karachi, where he read a letter from the Sheikh.
related_events: Maya questions the identity of Abu Ahmed

name: Daniel Interrogates Ammar with Threats and Intimidation
description: Daniel stands over Ammar, who is bound with ropes and bruised from a beating. Maya watches from a few feet behind Daniel, visibly uneasy, her hands trembling as she takes in the damp, foul-smelling room. Daniel begins speaking in a calm but intense tone, telling Ammar this moment is about coming to terms with his situation. He claims he could have had Ammar killed in Karachi but chose to let him live so they could talk. Ammar spits back that Daniel is a mid-level operative, a garbage man, unworthy of respect. Daniel retorts that Ammar is just a money man, a paperboy, and suddenly leans in close, his voice rising. He accuses Ammar of being involved in the murder of three thousand people, citing a five-thousand-dollar Western Union transfer from Ammar to a 9/11 hijacker. He also mentions finding 150 kilograms of high explosives in Ammar’s house. For a moment, Daniel laughs, backing away. He says he’s just messing with him, that he doesn’t want to talk about 9/11. Instead, he holds up a photo of Hazem al-Kashmiri and demands his Saudi email. He offers Ammar a blanket and food if he cooperates. Ammar remains silent. Daniel puts on gloves, then shoves Ammar to the floor. Guards move in and pin Ammar’s limbs. Daniel covers Ammar’s face with a towel. Ammar begins to thrash. Daniel orders Maya to get a bucket. She stumbles to the corner, fills a plastic pitcher from an ice chest, and brings it back. Daniel pours water over the towel on Ammar’s face. Ammar jerks in panic, gasping. Daniel continues, saying Hazem was friends with Ramzi Yousef and that they met in Tunisia in the 90s. Ammar chokes out that he doesn’t know anything. Maya shakes her head, her face pale.
related_events: Daniel confronts restrained Ammar during interrogation
Daniel reveals knowledge of Ammar's financial ties to a 9/11 hijacker
Daniel discloses discovery of high explosives in Ammar's house
related_occasions: Cia Interrogation Session At Black Site

name: Daniel Demands Hazem al-Kashmiri's Email
description: Daniel paces around Ammar, his anger flaring as he accuses him of being a disgrace and implicates him in mass murder. He leans in close, mentioning a Western Union transfer to a 9/11 hijacker and the 150 kilograms of high explosives found in Ammar's home. Then, suddenly, he laughs and says he's just messing with him. He pulls out a photograph and shows it to Ammar, identifying the man as Hazem al-Kashmiri. Daniel demands his Saudi email, insisting Ammar knows him. He offers a blanket and solid food in exchange. When Ammar refuses to respond, Daniel puts on gloves, signals to the guards, and forces Ammar to the ground. A towel is placed over Ammar's face, and Daniel orders Maya to bring water. She fills a bucket from an ice chest and hands it over, her hands trembling. Daniel pours water onto the towel covering Ammar's face as he struggles. Through gasps, Ammar says he doesn't know. Maya shakes her head.
related_events: Daniel shifts focus to the Saudi group and demands Hazem al-Kashmiri's email
related_occasions: Cia Interrogation Session At Black Site

name: Daniel Smothers Ammar with a Towel During Interrogation
description: Ammar remains silent after Daniel demands information about Hazem al-Kashmiri. Daniel puts on gloves, then suddenly pushes Ammar to the floor. Two guards move in quickly, pinning Ammar's limbs. Daniel covers Ammar's face with a towel. Ammar begins to thrash. Daniel signals to Maya, who hesitates before walking to a cooler in the corner. She fills a plastic pitcher with water and brings it over, her hands shaking. Daniel pours the water onto the towel over Ammar's face. Ammar jerks violently, gasping for air beneath the cloth.
related_events: Daniel initiates physical interrogation of Ammar by smothering his face with a towel
related_occasions: Cia Interrogation Session At Black Site

name: Water Pouring Interrogation of Ammar
description: Maya, following Daniel's command, walks to the corner of the room and fills a bucket from a plastic pitcher dipped into an ice chest filled with water. Her hands tremble as she carries it back. Daniel kneels beside Ammar, who is restrained and lying on the floor with a towel covering his face. Daniel begins pouring water from the bucket onto the towel, soaking it. Ammar jerks violently, gasping and struggling to breathe. As the water flows, Daniel leans in and says Hazem was connected to Ramzi Yousef and that they met in Tunisia. Ammar, choking and breathless, shouts that he doesn't know who Hazem is.
related_events: Maya retrieves water from ice chest and fills bucket under Daniel's instruction
Daniel begins water pouring on towel-covered face of Ammar
Daniel accuses Ammar of knowing Hazem through Ramzi Yousef and Tunisia connection
Ammar denies knowledge of Hazem under duress
related_occasions: Cia Interrogation Session At Black Site

name: Maya Shakes Her Head During Water Interrogation
description: Daniel pours water from a plastic pitcher onto a towel covering Ammar's face, forcing him to gasp and thrash against the restraints. Maya stands nearby, her hands trembling, her face pale. As Ammar struggles for breath, she shakes her head slightly, her eyes fixed on the scene with clear distress. She does not speak or move to intervene, but her expression darkens with discomfort as the interrogation continues.
related_events: Maya silently refuses or expresses disapproval of interrogation method
related_occasions: Cia Interrogation Session At Black Site

name: Daniel Escalates Interrogation with Water and Demands
description: Daniel stands over Ammar, who is still pinned to the floor with a towel over his face. Water drips steadily from a pitcher onto Ammar's nose, his breath coming in short, panicked gasps. Daniel leans in, demanding the emails of the remaining Saudi group members and the last known location of bin Laden. Ammar says nothing, his body tensing beneath the restraints. Frustrated, Daniel hurls the pitcher across the room. He yanks the towel from Ammar's face, pulling it hard, leaving him coughing and choking on the floor.
